name: Mads Christensen
bio:
Mads' journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly. After years managing a high-end restaurant in Copenhagen, a chance encounter with a Praga Racing team member led to an invitation to revamp their paddock hospitality. He saw an opportunity to bring a refined, sustainable approach to motorsport catering, focusing on fresh, locally-sourced ingredients and innovative culinary techniques.

Mads is driven by a desire to elevate the entire team's experience through exceptional food and service. He views catering not just as providing meals, but as a crucial element in fostering team morale and performance. His meticulous planning, attention to detail, and commitment to quality have earned him the respect of the entire Praga Racing team.

What sets Mads apart is his ability to balance the demanding logistical challenges of motorsport with a genuine passion for culinary excellence. He's not afraid to experiment with new flavors and techniques, always striving to create memorable dining experiences that fuel both body and spirit.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Mads is a man of medium build with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Insists on using only organic, locally-sourced ingredients whenever possible
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas and catering plans
Has a habit of humming quietly while inspecting the pantry
